messages:
Nora: quick report from a customer onboarding call — their python sampleapp started spewing DEBUG logs once OTEL_AUTO_INIT was true. very noisy and they saw duplicate request ids on retries.
Priyanka: thanks. which SDK & sample? python sdk v0.7.9?
Nora: python 0.9.0 in their manifest, but they tested java 1.2.0 too and saw parity issue: java preserves X-Request-Id, python did not.
Diego: can you paste the log fragment?
Nora: ```
INFO  http.client: calling POST /v1/generate headers={"X-Request-Id": "rq-0001"}
DEBUG auth: token refresh
DEBUG http.client: calling POST /v1/generate headers={"X-Request-Id": "rq-0002"}
```
Nora: also the body had a user message with an inline secret like `password: `supersecret`` and later logs showed the secret unredacted.
Priyanka: sounds like two separate regressions: (A) request id not propagated on retry in python SDK, (B) redaction ordering when otel auto-init is enabled.
Diego: for (A) the java sdk attaches request id to the context & retry layer reuses it. python retry implementation currently creates new context on each attempt. easy fix: if context.request_id present, reuse when building retry request.
Priyanka: add a unit test asserting: initial header X-Request-Id present on retry attempts and traces keep the same trace/span ids.
Nora: for (B) i dug into the sampleapp startup flow: otel auto-init runs and sets logger.setLevel(DEBUG) when OTEL_EXPORTER_DEBUG=1. our redaction middleware is registered later in the flask request pipeline, so earliest logs escape.
Diego: possible mitigations: (1) delay otel auto-init until after redaction registration, (2) make redaction synchronous at the logging handler level (i.e., filter logs before emission), or (3) prevent otel from toggling global logger level by default.
Priyanka: i prefer (2) + (3). logging filter as last-resort ensures we never emit secrets, and change otel_autoinit to respect REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_SAFE=true to avoid auto-debug behavior.
Nora: also propose adding a small snippet to the quickstart: "If you see unexpected DEBUG logs during onboarding, set OTEL_AUTO_INIT=0 or REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_SAFE=1 while you finish setup." saves support tickets.
Diego: i'll prototype a logging.Filter that runs redaction on message.getMessage() and then returns True. it will be added to both python and node sdks so parity is maintained.
Priyanka: file a ticket for sdk parity: DX-1190. include test matrix rows: python/node/java with OTEL_AUTO_INIT={0,1} and OTEL_EXPORTER_DEBUG={0,1}.
build-bot: created branch nx/redact-log-filter and queued CI for sdk/python (unit + integ).
devx-bot: ticket DX-1190 created: "redaction filter + preserve request id on retry (py)". linked PR #498.
Nora: thanks. Diego, when you have the filter ready pls add a tiny integration in sampleapp that simulates a 401+retry and a multi-line backtick secret payload so QA can confirm.
Diego: will do. aiming to have PR by EOD.
Priyanka: once merged, we'll roll a patch release and announce in #eng and the onboarding doc. also add a short FAQ entry in docs/telemetry.md.
Nora: great. customer was happy we prioritized. closing the loop in the onboarding notes helps a lot. :smile:
